title: Sam's Terrible Saturday
subtitle: Repaso para el examen A2: past simple y continuous, used to, cantidades…

content.instructions: Escribe la palabra que falta. Si hay una palabra entre paréntesis, úsala en la forma correcta.

items.text: Last Saturday ___ (be) a terrible day for Sam. He ___ (wake up) late because his phone ___ (not / ring). While he ___ (look for) his socks, Priya ___ (knock) on the door: "Sam! The bathroom is free!"
items.hint: Wake → woke. While + past continuous para la acción larga.

items.text: ___, Sam went to the kitchen. He wanted a big breakfast, but there wasn't ___ milk and there ___ (be) only one egg. "How ___ eggs have we got?" he shouted. "None!" Priya answered. He made a coffee, but it was ___ hot to drink, and he didn't have ___ time to wait.
items.hint: How many + contables (eggs). Too + adjetivo (demasiado); enough + nombre (suficiente).

items.text: So he ___ (go) to the shop in his pyjamas. It ___ (rain) when he ___ (leave) the house. While he ___ (pay), he ___ (see) Mrs Green behind him. She ___ (look) at his pyjamas and ___ (smile) ___ (polite). Sam felt really embarrassed.
items.hint: La acción larga en past continuous, la corta en past simple. Adverbio de modo: adjetivo + -ly.
items.explanation: It was raining (acción en curso) when he left (acción corta que ocurre en medio).

items.text: Sam wasn't always like this. When he was at school, he ___ (use to / get up) at seven every day and he ___ (not / use to / be) late. His mum ___ (use to / say) that he was a very tidy boy! These days he ___ (often / sleep) until ten, and he ___ (work) at the pub until late.
items.hint: Afirmativa: used to + verbo. Negativa: didn't use to (sin -d).
items.explanation: Con didn't el verbo vuelve a la forma base: didn't use to, no «didn't used to».

items.text: In the afternoon Sam ___ (take) his guitar to The Old Duke. On the way, it ___ (start) to rain again and he ___ (not / have) an umbrella. He ___ (step) in a big puddle and ___ (arrive) at the pub soaked. ___, at eight o'clock, the concert started.
items.hint: Step → stepped: se dobla la consonante final.

items.text: Sam ___ (play) the first song very ___ (bad): he ___ (forget) the words! But the people ___ (love) it. They ___ (think) it was a joke, and everybody ___ (laugh) ___ (happy).

On Sunday Javi ___ (call) Lucía. "___ (Sam / do) right now?" he asked. "He ___ (sleep) on the sofa," Lucía said. "He ___ (always / sleep) on Sundays. And he ___ (want) to sing that song again next Friday!"
items.hint: Ahora mismo: present continuous. Costumbre: present simple. Want no va en continuous.
items.explanation: Want es un verbo de estado: he wants, nunca «he is wanting».
